label: Confirm sign up
subject: Confirm your email — ClipForge
preheader: One last step before your first cut. Confirm your email to get started.
headline:
Welcome to
ClipForge.
body: Confirm your email address to save your projects and start creating your next great clip.
security: Didn't create a ClipForge account? You can safely ignore this email. No action is needed.

label: Invite user
subject: You're invited to ClipForge
preheader: Your invitation to create with ClipForge is here.
headline:
You're invited
to ClipForge.
body: You've been invited to create an account on ClipForge. Accept your invitation and start shaping your next story.
note: This invitation is intended for the recipient of this email.
security: Not expecting an invitation? You can ignore this email. Only accept invitations you trust.

label: Magic link or OTP
subject: Your sign-in link — ClipForge
preheader: Use this secure link to return to your ClipForge account.
headline:
Welcome back.
Let's create.
body: Ready to pick up where you left off? Use the button below to sign in to your ClipForge account.
note: This is a single-use sign-in link. Keep it private.
security: Didn't request this sign-in link? Ignore this email and don't share the link with anyone.

label: Change email address
subject: Confirm your email change — ClipForge
preheader: Confirm the requested change to your ClipForge email address.
headline:
New email.
Same creator.
body: We received a request to change your ClipForge email address to {{ .NewEmail }}. Confirm this change below.
note: You may need to confirm the change from both your current and new inbox.
security: Didn't request this change? Don't confirm it. Visit ClipForge directly to review your account security and contact support.

label: Reset password
subject: Reset your password — ClipForge
preheader: Choose a new password for your ClipForge account.
headline:
Reset your
password.
body: We received a password reset request for your ClipForge account. Follow the link below to choose a new password.
note: Choose a strong, unique password that you don't use elsewhere.
security: Didn't request a password reset? You can ignore this email. Your password won't change unless you complete the reset.

label: Reauthentication
subject: Your verification code — ClipForge
preheader: Use this code to confirm it's you. Never share it.
headline:
Let's confirm
it's you.
body: Enter this verification code in ClipForge to confirm it's you and continue your requested account action.
note: Enter the code only in ClipForge. We will never ask you to share it by email or chat.
security: Didn't request this code? Don't share or use it. Visit ClipForge directly to review your account security.
